description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow alterations to lower the parapet to unit 4 balcony, insertion of a Velux window to Unit 7 on the North elevation, and insertion of an Automatic Opening Vent (AOV) over the communal stair following planning permission 01689/D/P7 Appeal Ref: APP/F5540/W/19/3223651 dated 12/08/2019 for demolition of existing building and the erection of a part one, part two and three storey block providing seven residential units and associated access, amenity space, landscaping, refuse storage and car and cycle parking.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the plans and documents referenced as follows: 3111-00-0000 A; 3111-00-0010; 3111-00-0011; 3111-00-0020; 3111-00-0021; 3111-00-0022; 3111-00-0023; 3111-02-0003 J; 3111-04-0000 K; 3111-04-0001 K; 3111-04-0002 K; 3111-04-0003 K; 3111-02-0004 C; 3111-11-0002 K; 3111-11-0004 K; 2017-007-L01; Design and Access Statement (October 2018); Transport Technical Note (October 2018); Planning Statement (October 2018); Energy Report (October 2018); Water Conservation Strategy (October 2018); Daylight and Sunlight Report (October 2018); Flood Risk Assessment (October 2018). FR101-PLN-04 Rev C8: Received 30/05/2022. FR101-ELE-02 Rec C10, FR101-ELE-010 Rev C12: Received 30/06/2022.

Condition : 2 - 2.	Works shall be carried out in accordance with the agreed details for the proposed materials approved under application 01689/D/P7(3i) on 09/08/2021. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 3 - 3.	Works shall be carried out in accordance with the agreed details for the Construction Logistics Plan approved under application 01689/D/P7(4) on 29/03/2021. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - 4.	Works shall be carried out in accordance with the agreed details for the privacy screens and obscure glazing approved under application 01689/D/P7(5-17) on 10/05/2022. These details shall be implemented prior to the first occupation of the development and maintained in perpetuity.

Condition : 5 - 5.	Works shall be carried out in accordance with the agreed details for the cycle storage approved under application 01689/D/P7(5-17) on 10/05/2022. The scheme shall be carried out as approved and retained at all times thereafter.

Condition : 6 - 6.	Works shall be carried out in accordance with the agreed details for the detailed drainage design and management plan approved under application 01689/D/P7(5-17) on 10/05/2022. The site shall achieve a post-development runoff rate of 1 l/s using permeable paving and underground storage, discharging into a surface water sewer.

Condition : 7 - 7.	No building hereby permitted shall be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and installation contracts) demonstrating that the final detailed drainage scheme for the site (the subject of Condition 7 of this permission) has been completed in accordance with the submitted details has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components.

Condition : 8 - 8.	The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Energy Report (October 2018) and works shall be carried out in accordance with the agreed details for the full Design Stage calculations under the Standard Assessment Procedure showing that the development has achieved a 35% reduction in emissions when compared to part L of the Building Regulations 2013 as approved under application 01689/D/P7(3-17) on 20/11/2022.

Condition : 9 - 9.	Prior to the first occupation of the development, evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure) showing that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Report (October 2018) and has achieved a 35% reduction in emissions when compared to part L of the Building Regulations 2013 shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.
Condition : 10 - Works shall be carried out in accordance with the agreed details for the internal water use approved under application 01689/D/P7(3-15) on 06/06/2022.

Condition : 11 - The development materials shall be selected in accordance with the building fabric requirements set out in the approved Energy Report (October 2018). At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (i.e. external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) shall achieve a rating of A+ to D under the Building Research Establishment's (BRE) Green Guide of specification. At least 50% of timber and timber products shall be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) sources/schemes. No construction or insulation materials shall be used that release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone. The development shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the full requirements of this condition has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 12 - 1.	Works shall be carried out in accordance with the agreed details for the refuse strategy approved under application 01689/D/P7(5-17) on 10/05/2022. The arrangements for storing waste and recyclable materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be implemented before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied and retained as such thereafter.
Condition : 13 - Works shall be carried out in accordance with the agreed details for the landscaping approved under application 01689/D/P7(14) on 22/12/2022.

Condition : 14 - Works shall be carried out in accordance with the agreed details for the boundary treatments approved under application 01689/D/P7(5-17) on 10/05/2022. The approved details shall be completed before the units are occupied and retained as approved at all times thereafter.

Condition : 15 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0900 to 1300 on Saturdays and not at all on Sundays and Public Holidays.

Condition : 16 - Works shall be carried out in accordance with the agreed details for the land contamination Phase 1 and 2 reports approved under application 01689/D/P7(3-17) on 20/11/2020. During the course of the development the local planning authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the local planning authority for written approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.

Condition : 17 - The car parking and manoeuvring areas shown on the approved ground floor site plan (3111-02-0003 J) shall be provided before the development to which they relate is first occupied. Thereafter these areas shall not be used for any purpose other than for the parking and manoeuvring of vehicles associated with the residential occupation of the site and shall be permanently retained for such purposes.

Condition : 18 - Works shall be carried out in accordance with the agreed details for the method statement approved under application 01689/D/P7(19) on 19/10/2020. All works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
